## Summary

I've successfully resolved ticket T-4004. The notification-worker pods were failing to send email because they were trying to reach `smtp-relay` using a short name that only resolves within the `notify` namespace. When the platform team moved smtp-relay to the `shared-infra` namespace on Sunday night, the DNS lookups started failing.

The fix is straightforward: update the SMTP_HOST configuration from `smtp-relay` to the fully qualified domain name `smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local`, which allows cross-namespace service resolution according to Kubernetes DNS specifications.
